title: Respiratory Assessment: Symptoms and Measurements
objective: Distinguish a subjective breathing symptom from an abnormal breathing rate and a routine measurement.

vocabulary.definition: A person's subjective feeling of difficult or uncomfortable breathing.
vocabulary.example: The patient reports dyspnea when walking upstairs.
The nurse notes tachypnea during the assessment.

vocabulary.definition: The number of breaths a person takes per minute.
vocabulary.example: Record the respiratory rate as part of the vital signs.

quiz.question: Which term means an abnormally rapid breathing rate?
quiz.explanation: Tachypnea means an abnormally rapid respiratory rate. Dyspnea is the subjective feeling of breathing difficulty; respiratory rate is the breaths-per-minute measurement.
